Here is a full transcription of the Latin marriage register entries shown in **image_e16ea6.png**.

The register is split into two columns, covering the latter half of **1856** and transitioning into January **1857** at the bottom right. Abbreviations have been transcribed as written, and uncertain letters or names are indicated in brackets.

---

## Left Page (1856)

### Juli (July)

* **12**

> In Matrimonio Conjunxit Rev[erendu]s T. Gleeson, Michaelem Russell & Catharinam Croak, hujusce Parochiæ Ambo. Nullo detecto impedimento et habita in bannis dispensatione. Testibus: Jacobo et Ellena Madden.
> — **Lau[rence] Harnett C[oadjutor] Croom**

* **20**

> Item Conj[unxit] David Cahill et Margaritam Drooly, Hujusce Parochiæ ambo. Nullo detecto impedimento et habita in Bannis dispensatione. Testibus: Jacobo Hennesy et Ellena Hickey.
> — **Lau[rence] Harnett P[arochus] Dit[to]**

* **27**

> Item Conj[unxit] Sylvestrem Wild et Ell[enam] Eaton, hujusce Parochiæ ambo. Nullo detecto impedimento et habita in Bannis dispensatione. Testibus: Jacobo Enright et Honora Lyons.
> — **Lau[rence] Harnett**
> *[Note in margin: Pat[rick] Wild]*

### Aug[usti] (August)

* **19**

> Joannem Bridgeman & Brigidam Heffernan de Cloughland, cum Parochiæ licentia mat[rimoni]o junxi coram Thoma Bridgeman et Honora Cash[man].
> — **Joannes Hayes V[icarius] P[arochialis]**

* **24**

> Mich[aele]m Hickey & Catharinam White cum Parochiæ licentia mat[rimoni]o junxi coram Jacobo Barrett & Marg[are]ta Healy.
> — **Joannes Hayes V.P.**

* **24**

> Joannem Dwyer & Honoram Savage cum Parochiæ licentia mat[rimoni]o junxi coram Thoma Lawler & Catharina Clanchy.
> — **Joannes Hayes. Lau[rence] Harnett**

### 7bris (September)

* **6**

> Danielem Connell & Annam White de Croom cum Parochiæ licentia mat[rimoni]o junxi coram Thoma Donovan & Maria Sheerin.
> — **Joannes Hayes V.P.**

* **16**

> Gulielmum Griffin & Lucindam Stritch acatholicam, habita ordinarii dispensatione et cum Parochiæ licentia.
> **Item**, mat[rimoni]o junxi coram Timotheo Danaher & Maria O'Brien.

* **16**

> Gulielmum Sullivan & Helenam Hardinge cum Parochiæ licentia mat[rimoni]o junxi coram Timotheo Donohoe & Brigida Quilligan.
> — **Joannes Hayes V.P.**

### 1857

### Januarii (January)

* **29**

> In Matrimonio Con[j]unx[it] Rev[erendu]s T. Gleeson, Henricum Walsh & Margaritam Ryan, hujusce Parochiæ ambo. Nullo detecto impedimento et habita in Bannis dispensatione. Testibus: Patricio & Maria Walsh.
> — **Lau[rence] Harnett Croom**
